data.content_ref: inline:SRC_002 contradicts SRC_004 on the role of thermal mass: SRC_002 claims geometry alone (SVF) explains nocturnal UHI variance, while SRC_004's overturn condition admits that thermal mass and evapotranspiration differences might dominate, effectively conceding that geometry is not always the sole governor. This contradiction is refuted if the counterconditions in SRC_002 are shown to be identical in empirical scope to the overturn conditions in SRC_004, meaning both silently assume the same background conditions and differ only in rhetorical emphasis.
